description: This file contains Python source code defining analysis and roadmap functions for a career navigation platform, specifically for processing skills, roles, and user progress data to generate gap analyses and visualizations.

methods.name: List[Tuple[Skill,int]] _role_required_skill_map(db: Session, role_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of skills with the required levels for a given role.

methods.name: int _user_skill_level(db: Session, user_id: str, skill_id: int)
methods.description: Gets the current skill level of a user for a specific skill.

methods.name: GapAnalysisOutput compute_gap_analysis(db: Session, payload: GapAnalysisInput, user_id: str = "anonymous")
methods.description: Calculates strengths, gaps, and recommendations based on user progress and target role skills.

methods.name: RoadmapOutput build_roadmap(payload: RoadmapInput, current_label: str = "Current", target_label: str = "Target")
methods.description: Generates a visual roadmap of skills and roles using Cytoscape elements based on gap analysis.
